data.gender_notes: Naheed is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Naheed is derived from the Persian word 'Naheed', meaning delicate, refined, and noble. It is often associated with the concept of being high-ranking or of noble status. The name Naheed carries the meaning “Delicate, refined, and noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naheed usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, refined, and noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Naheed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, refined, and noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naheed total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ناهد
in_arabic.meaning: حامل الأمل، من أصل قوي، رقيق
in_arabic.long_meaning: ناهد مصدر عربي يأتي من الجذر ن- ح- د، يدل على حمل الأمل، وهو اسم فريد يشير إلى الشخص الذي يعتبر مصدرًا لموضوع الأمل. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم لوصف الشخص الذي يمتلك روحًا قوية ومستقرة، وينبغي أن يكون قويًا ومتينًا في مواجهة تحديات الحياة. في الإسلام، يُعتبر حمل الأمل وسيلةً للتواصل مع الله، ويمكن أن يؤدي ذلك إلى تحقيق السعادة والنجاح. في هذا السياق، يعد اسم ناهد اسمًا مناسبًا لشخصية تحمل قيمًا إيجابية وتحترم الأمل في كل شئ.

in_english.name: Naheed

In Islamic tradition, carrying hope is a way to connect with God, and it can lead to happiness and success. A person with the name Naheed is considered hopeful, strong, and gentle, with a good character and a positive outlook on life. They are optimistic, virtuous, and have a strong sense of morality. In modern times, the name Naheed is popular in many Muslim cultures, and it is seen as a symbol of hope, strength, and gentleness.
